execution.raw_text:
```sql
SELECT DISTINCT td.pref_name AS target_description
FROM assays a
JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid
WHERE a.assay_organism = 'Not specified'
ORDER BY td.pref_name
```
